faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about ChronoFlow
faq.answer1: Yes, you can click on the flag and enjoy the features in English. The interface automatically adapts to your preferred language.
faq.answer2: Your data is stored in Europe and protected according to GDPR standards. We use end-to-end encryption and secure servers to ensure the confidentiality of your information.
faq.question3: Can I connect my Google Calendar?
faq.answer3: Yes, Google Calendar integration is available to synchronize your events. You can import your appointments and automatically sync your schedule.
